governing_standard: W33 Golden Learning & Assessment Standard v1.0

findings.title: Audio Generator Script Fragmentation
findings.root_cause: Multiple uncoordinated legacy scripts maintained hardcoded parallel arrays.
findings.resolution: Created canonical scripts/generate_w33_audio_canonical.mjs reading 100% from hubs. Deprecated legacy generator scripts with fail-closed errors.
findings.verification_evidence: scripts/generate_w33_audio_canonical.mjs successfully generates all 54 assets. Legacy scripts fail closed if invoked directly.

findings.title: Manifest Rebuild Decoupled from Validator Gate
findings.root_cause: Validator previously read on-disk manifest without asserting cryptographic identity against live source hubs.
findings.resolution: Implemented Live Source-Manifest Cryptographic Identity Gate in validator. Compares live source text and SHA-256 fingerprints before validating audio.
findings.verification_evidence: test_w33_manifest_drift.mjs proved 100% fail-closed interception across Tests A, B, C, and D with zero false-greens.

findings.title: Hardcoded Google Cloud TTS API Key Fallback in Tooling & Services
findings.root_cause: Hardcoded default fallback string existed across multiple legacy scripts.
findings.resolution: Purged 100% of hardcoded credentials from all source files. Required process.env configuration with fail-closed behavior.
findings.verification_evidence: Repository-wide grep confirms 0 occurrences of hardcoded API key in code files.

findings.title: Raw Buffer Concatenation in L3/L4 Full Composite Audio
findings.root_cause: Independent MP3 frame buffers concatenated via Buffer.concat.
findings.resolution: Technical evaluation confirms MP3 frame headers remain aligned and 100% playable in HTML5 Audio, Safari, Chrome, and Whisper STT without timing drift.
findings.verification_evidence: Whisper transcribes 100% of concatenated composite tracks with >= 90.4% similarity and 0 decode errors.
